run_whisper_transcription: run WhisperModule to transcribe audio files from a manifest into a TSV output file
configure_whisper_module: create a WhisperConfig dataclass to set model, language, output directory, and runtime requirements
iterate_audio_segments: use iterate_audios to yield waveform tensors and audio info from a manifest file
parse_audio_lines: use get_lines to iterate over audio segments and extract file paths with timestamps
load_audio_segment: use get_audio to read and slice an audio file at a given sampling rate and time range
